svg.aria-label: Where the product sits in the Blue Rewards system. The product is an enhanced experience inside the existing Blue Rewards app and website, nested within the programme systems of record, which are nested within BMO. The member is to the left, evidence authorities to the right, and forces outside the boundary across the top. It holds none of the records; what it changes is how much of the available value a member ends up with, by helping them find what is worth having, decide on it, follow it through, and recover it when it goes missing. Three feedback loops explain why realized value stays lower than it could be, and five leverage points act on those loops.

Available value does not reliably become realized value.
Members miss opportunities worth having, cannot tell what they are owed, and give up when value goes missing.
Realized value is the main variable. These three loops are why it stays lower than it could be:
should raise realized value — but its return leg is unconfirmed
caps realized value by limiting how generous offers can be
drains realized value by turning delay into withdrawal
One minus and a delay. The lag before a member can confirm that a purchase
counted, or that a missing reward is being handled, is what manufactures doubt.
